cmd.pidsymbol.help: Ku dhig calaamadaha P&ID: faalfayaasha, qalabka, aaladaha, walxaha khadka ku jira iyo isku-xidhayaasha. Calaamad khadka habka ku riixo ayaa khadka ka jarta labada dhinac.
cmd.pidline.help: Sawir khad habka ama khad calaamadeed (hawo, korontada, software, kabilaari). Khad habka waxa uu leeyahay lambar khad oo laga sameeyay cabbirka, adeegga, tirada iyo qeexida.
cmd.pidtag.help: Siiso calaamadda iyo sharaxaadda qalab, ama calaamadee dhammaan qalabka aan calaamad lahayn mar keliya (A).
cmd.pidln.help: Dejii cabbirka, adeegga iyo qeexida khadadka habka, oo lambaree.
cmd.pidlist.help: Ku dhig liiska khadadka, liiska qalabka, tusaha aaladaha ama liiska faalfayaasha xaashida, oo ah miis wax cusboonaysiiya.
cmd.pidcheck.help: Hubi naqshadda calaamadaha aan calaamad lahayn, calaamadaha isku mid ah, dhamaadka khadadka furan iyo wax kale, oo mid walba u gudub.
ask.tag.inst: Calaamadda aaladda: xarfo (FIC) ama xarfo iyo lambar (FIC-101)
ask.pidtag: Riix calaamad si aad u calaamadiso
ask.line.next: Geeska xigta ee {style} (Enter si aad u dhamaysato)
ask.pidln: Riix khad si aad u dejiso (adeeg {svc}, cabbir {size}, qeex {spec}; lambar cusub mar kasta: {next})
ask.table: Geeska miiska (Enter si aad uga boodo)
ask.check.zoom: Lambarka la xooqayo (1 ilaa {n}, Enter si aad u dhamaysato)
done.autotag.skipped: {n} aaladood waxay u baahan yihiin xarfahooda: calaamadee mid mid.
done.table: Liiska waa uu xaashida ku yaal oo wuu cusboonaysiinayaa.
err.notline: Halkaas ma jiro khad habka ama calaamadeed.
warn.maxpts: Khad waxa uu hayaa ugu badnaan 100 dhibcood.
check.open-end: Khadka {style} ({ln}) wuxuu ku dhammaadaa wax aan lahayn.
check.no-line-number: Khad habka ma leh lambar khad.
check.ln-changes: Khadka {a} wuxuu ku dhegaa khadka {b} iyada oo aan wax ka dhexeeyin: ku dar yareeye ama jebinta qeexida.
check.inst-alone: Aaladda {tag} ma leh khad ku xidhan.
proc.err.file: Faylkaas ma aha moodeel warshadeed oo CadCraft ah.
proc.err.none: Sawirkan weli ma laha moodeel warshadeed. Fur IMPORT, ama ka codso caawiyaha inuu warshad dhiso.
proc.err.noinst: Ma jiro qalab ama valve calaamadda leh oo la dhoofin karo.
proc.done.run: {units} unug iyo {streams} stream; {linked} oo cusub lagu xidhay sawirkan. {errors} khalad, {warnings} digniin.
proc.done.size: {ln} hadda waa {size}: {n} qayb oo xariiq ayaa la cusboonaysiiyay; xawaaraha {v} m/s, hoos u dhac {dp} bar.
cmd.pidproc.help: Ku xidh sawirka moodeelka warshadda, socodsii, sawir miiska stream-yada, beddel baaxadda xariiq oo ku dheji, ama liis xariiqyada nidaamka xakameynta.
ctl.io: Kanaalada: {ai} analog gelin, {ao} analog soo saar, {di} digital gelin, {do} digital soo saar (ka hor alaabta dheeraadka ah).
ctl.noloops: Calaamadaha dhexdooda lama helin wareeg leh laba qalab ama ka badan.
ctl.loops.done: {n} xaashi oo wareeg ayaa la sawiray.
import.dexpi.empty: {name} ma haysto qalab, valve ama xariiq oo P&ID-kan calaamado u leeyahay.
cmd.pidcalc.help: Socodsii xisaabiye warshadeed (flash, flowsheet, exchanger, vessel, network, pipe stress, relief, HAZOP, LOPA, consequence iyo wax ka badan) oo eeg natiijooyinkiisa iyo Dhibaatooyinka.
calc.lede: Dooro xisaabiye, wax ka beddel tusaalaha gelinta, oo socodsii. Waa caawin xisaab, ma aha ansixin injineer: joogteyaasha la qoro waa lagu calaamadeeyay in dib loo eego.
calc.badjson: Gelinta ma aha JSON sax ah: {why}
calc.unknown: Ma jiro xisaabiye magiciisu yahay {id}. Isku day: {list}
cmd.pidzone.help: Ka sawir aagagga khatarta ee xisaabiyaha aagga sawirka: wareegyo qorshe ah, ama goyn xagga sii dayntu marayso. Dabaqyada AREA-ZONE0, AREA-ZONE1 iyo AREA-ZONE2. Natiijo baaritaan, ma aha ansixin injineer.
zone.none: Ma jiro aag la sawiro: marka hore socodsii xisaabiyaha aagga oo eeg Dhibaatooyinka.
cmd.pidhazop.help: Dib u eeg safafka HAZOP ee caawiyahaagu soo jeediyay: aqbal ama diid iyaga oo magacaaga la sheegayo. Caawiyuhu safka naftiisa ma aqbali karo.
hazop.none: Weli ma jiro xaashi HAZOP: sawir qalab iyo calaamado, ama ka codso caawiyahaaga inuu nuqtooyin ka soo jeediyo P&ID-kan.
hazop.head: Xaashiga HAZOP: {nodes} nuqtooyin, {rows} safaf, {open} oo sugaya kooxda.
hazop.ask: Aqbal (A), Diid (R) ama Enter si ay u sii joogaan
hazop.ids: Safafka noocee (aqoonsiyada sida R1 R2, ama dhammaan)
hazop.nopick: Ma jiro safaf la mid ah aqoonsiyadaas.
hazop.nowho: Go'aan wuxuu u baahan yahay magac. Wax lama beddelin.
feeds.none: Miiska stream-yada kalfadhigan lama soo dejin. Marka hore isticmaal Import › Miiska stream-yada (CSV ama Excel).
feeds.done: {n} feed(s) ee moodeelka warshadda ayaa laga dejiyay {name}; {skipped} stream aan la dabaqin.
cmd.pidfeeds.help: Ku dejiso feed-yada moodeelka warshadda miiska stream-yada aad soo dejisay (Import › Miiska stream-yada (CSV ama Excel)).
sketch.lede: Qaab-dhismeed sawir: riix si aad atom u dhigto (wuxuu ku biiraa midka calaamadaysan), riix laba atom si aad u xidho, riix mar kale labada atom ee xariiqda si uu u noqdo xidhiidh laba-jibbaaran ama saddex-jibbaaran. Midig-riix ayaa silsiladda dhamaynaya.
sketch.hint: Riix aagga sawirka si aad atom koowaad u dhigto.
sketch.ringhint: Riix meel madhan si aad fardaha u dhigto.
wire.in: Xariiqda {ln} waa {size} 3D. P&ID ayaa qaaday ({n} qayb oo xariiq ayaa la beddelay).
wire.in.model: Moodeel warshad ayaa yimid ({name}); {n} qayb oo xariiq ayaa la beddelay.
cmd.pidsources.help: Akhri ilaha sii-deynta qalabka iyo fittings-ka sawirka, ku kala-saar iyaga xisaabiyaha aagga, oo kaydi aagagga PIDZONE. Natiijo baaritaan, ma aha ansixin injineer; injineer ma eegin.
cmd.pidconseq.help: Ka sawir aagagga xisaabiyaha natiijada (goobaha kulaylka, qarax ama baalasha qiiqa) sawirka dabaqyada CONSEQ-1, CONSEQ-2 … Natiijo baaritaan; injineer ma eegin.
cmd.pidrelief.help: Cabbir valve-ka xad-dhaafka ee sawirka adigoo isticmaalaya gelinta xisaabiyaha xad-dhaafka, oo ku qor xarfka godka iyo aagiisa calaamadda. Injineer ma eegin.
src.badjson: Taasi ma aha JSON sax ah.
src.done: {n} aag oo ka timid {items} shay oo sawirka ka mid ah. Socodsii PIDZONE si aad u sawirto.
ask.consequence: Xagee ka soo baxaa sii-deynta (barta qorshaha)?
conseq.done: {n} aag oo saamayn ah ayaa la sawiray.
relief.none: Sawirka ma jiro valve xad-dhaafka ah.
relief.badtag: Ma jiro valve xad-dhaafka ah oo calaamadda {tag} leh.
relief.badbasis: Ku qor gas, steam ama liquid.
cmd.pidpfd.help: Ka sawir sawirka socodka warshadda ee moodeelka: unugyada tiirarka ku jira sida socodka, stream-yada magacyadooda, heerkulka iyo cadaadiska, dib-u-soo-celinta sare, iyo miiska stream-yada hoostiisa.
cmd.pidhen.help: Ka sawir shabakadda isdhaafsiga kulaylka ee xogta stream-yada (naqshadda pinch): stream-yada kulul sare, kuwa qabow hoose, khadka pinch, isku-xidhka iyo waajibaadkooda, kulaystayaasha iyo qaboojiyayaasha.
cmd.pidnode.help: Ka sawir xadka nuqtada HAZOP laba geesood. Calaamadaha qalabka iyo lambarada xariiqda ku jira ayaa buuxiya nuqtada, waana la kaydiyaa sawirka.
cmd.pidlive.help: Dhig qiimayaasha warshadda calaamadaha goobaha ku dhegan, midabka ku salaysan xaaladda: faylka CSV ee taariikhda (tag,time,value,quality) ama xidhiidhka warshadda ee Studio. Kaliya akhris.
cmd.pidtubesheet.help: Ka sawir miiska tuubooyinka exchanger-ka xogta gelinta xisaabiyaha exchanger-ka: qolofta, tuubo kasta, iyo waddada marinka.
cmd.pidplume.help: Ka sawir khadadka heerka qiiqa ee xagaga xisaabiyaha hawada sawirka, oo leh xagaga, fallaadha dabaysha iyo qoraal ah in tani ay tahay baaritaan, ma aha qaab ogolaansho.
pfd.ask: Geeska hoose ee bidix ee sawirka (Enter si aad u joojiso)
pfd.nosolve: Flowsheet-ku ma xallin ({why}); sawirka waxaa lagu sawiray adigoo aan heerkul iyo cadaad lahayn.
pfd.done: Sawirka socodka warshadda ee {units} unug ayaa la sawiray ({n} shay) oo leh miiska stream-yadiisa.
hen.ask.streams: Xogta stream-yada JSON ahaan [{{Ts, Tt, CP}}…] (CP kW/K, hal miisaan heerkul)
hen.badjson: Xogta stream-yada ma aha JSON sax ah.
hen.ask.at: Geeska sare ee bidix ee shabakadda (Enter si aad u joojiso)
hen.done: Shabakadda waa la sawiray: {matches} isku-xidh, {heaters} kulaystayaal, {coolers} qaboojiyayaal, {units} unug marka loo eego ugu yaraanta {min} ({n} shay).
node.ask.a: Geeska koowaad ee nuqtada (Enter si aad u joojiso)
node.ask.name: Magaca nuqtada
node.noname: Nuqtadu waxay u baahan tahay magac.
node.done: Nuqta {id} {name}: {tags} shay calaamadeysan iyo {lines} xariiq gudaheeda. Waa la kaydiyay sawirka.
live.notags: Ma jiro calaamado calaamadeysan oo sawirka ku jira si qiimayaasha looga dhigo.
live.ask.csv: Akhrisyada CSV oo safka koowaad uu yahay tag,time,value,quality (isticmaal \n si aad u jabiso safafka), ama Enter si aad u akhrido xidhiidhka warshadda Studio
live.needs: Akhrisyada ku sii CSV, ama fur sawirkan CadCraft Studio oo oggolow xidhiidhka warshadda. Browser-ka keligiis ma akhrin karo warshad.
live.done: {n} silsiladda qiimaha ayaa la dhigay, {missing} calaamado aan lahayn shay, {problems} qoraal oo ku jira Dhibaatooyinka.
plume.ask.wind: Dabaysha ka timaadda (darajo saacad-mid ah laga bilaabo woqooyi)
plume.done: Qiiqa waa la sawiray: {contours} khad heer ({n} shay). Baaritaan, ma aha AERMOD.
loops.lede: Ku xidh xakameeyaha kasta ee sawirka wixii uu akhriyo oo uu wado ee moodeelka warshadda, socodsii, oo shaqee wejiyada. Moodeel ayaa, ma aha warshad dhab ah.
loops.spec: Moodeelka warshadda (JSON: tangiyo, reactor-yo, valve-yo, ilaha)
loops.none: Weli ma jiro wareeg xakameeye ku leh sawirkan.
loops.nobound: Weli xakameeye lama xidhin qiyaas iyo wax-soo-saar.
live.lede: Ka muuji akhrisyada warshad ama dhismo ku jira sawirka. Kaliya akhris: waxba halkan ma qorayo qalab, ma kiciyo digniinna. Qalab ku jira cinwaan dadweyne wuxuu u baahan yahay ogolaashahaaga martigeliyahaas.
live.check.done: {tags} calaamado oo ku jira {devices} qalab ayaa la hubiyay: {problems} shay oo la eego.
live.bridge.none: Akhrinta qalab waxay u baahan tahay CadCraft Studio: bogga browser-ka ma furi karo xidhiidh shabakad warshadeed. Ilaa hadda isticmaal CSV akhrisyo.
live.note: Xogta warshadda iyo dhismaha oo kaliya akhris ah, si loo eego oo loo barbar dhigo. Ma aha nidaam digniin ama hawl badbaado.
timer.lede: Ku hay kalfadhiga HAZOP wakhtigiisa. Daqiiqadaha nuqta kasta dhig, saacadda bilow nuqta kooxdu ka hadlayso, oo u gudub markay dhammaato. Wakhtiga dhaafay waa la muujiyaa, lama qasbo.
timer.none: Weli nuqta ma jirto. Marka hore nuqta ku sawir PIDNODE.
timer.idle: Ma jiro node miiska ku jira.
timer.session: Waa la isticmaalay {used} oo ka mid ah {planned}
timer.note: Caawin waxbarasho oo koox ah. Waxay diiwaangelisaa waqtiga; ma go'aamiso in node la dhammeeyay.
cmd.pidcapeopen.help: La wadaag moodeelkan habaynta barnaamijyada simulatorka ee aqbala qaybaha CAPE-OPEN (Windows), ama isticmaal unug CAPE-OPEN ah oo barnaamij kale ka yimid moodeelkan. Weli lama tijaabin simulator.
co.summary: Xirmada "{name}": {model} oo leh {n} kombaound, iyo hawlgalkan unugyada: {units}.
co.classes: Studio wuxuu diiwaangelinayaa {n} fasal isticmaalaha Windows-kaaga (ma loo baahna xuquuqda maamule).
co.windows: CAPE-OPEN waxa uu shaqeeyaa kaliya CadCraft Studio ee Windows, qaybta Studio-na weli lama dhisin ama lama tijaabin. Eeg mawduuca caawimada CAPE-OPEN.
co.nobridge: Nuqulkan ma leh buundada CAPE-OPEN. Waxa loo baahan yahay CadCraft Studio ee Windows oo qaybta CAPE-OPEN lagu rakibay, taas oo weli aan diyaar ahayn. Unugga wuxuu ku sii jiraa moodeelka waana la dhaafaa marka moodeelka la orodo.
co.solve.none: Moodeelka habaynta ma leh unug CAPE-OPEN. Ku dar mid adigoo dooranaya "Isticmaal unug CAPE-OPEN".
co.solved: Orodku wuu dhammaaday. Isku dhowaaday: {ok}. Unugyada barnaamijka kale {calls} jeer ayay shaqeeyeen {passes} marxaladood.
co.list.none: Studio ma helin unug CAPE-OPEN ah kombiyuutarkan.
co.ask.prog: ProgID-ga unugga ama aqoonsiga fasalka (laga helo dukumentiga barnaamijka kale)
co.ask.in: Socodka soo galaya (magacyada moodeelka, kala saar comma)
co.ask.out: Socodka cusub ee soo baxaya (kala saar comma)
co.ask.inports: Magacyada albaabbada gelinta unugga, isla tartibta oo kale
co.ask.outports: Magacyada albaabbada soo-baxa unugga, isla tartibta oo kale
co.ask.params: Halbeegyada la dejinayo, sida Pressure=300000; Efficiency=0.7 (unugyada SI; ka tag haddii aan loo baahnayn)
co.bad.id: "{id}" lama isticmaali karo: waa inuu ku bilaabmaa xaraf, ilaa 24 xaraf yahay, oo aan horay moodeelka ugu jirin.
co.bad.prog: Taasi ma aha ProgID (sida Vendor.Unit.1) ama aqoonsi fasal oo dhex ku jira xidhmo.
co.bad.out: Socod kasta oo cusub waa inuu magac cusub yeeshaa: ku bilaabo xaraf, ilaa 24 xaraf, oo aan horay moodeelka ugu jirin.
co.bad.ports: Magac albaab keliya u geli socod kasta.
co.bad.param: Halbeegyada u qor sida Magac=qiime, kala saaray far-kabo (;).
co.added: Unugga {id} ({prog}) waxa lagu daray moodeelka habaynta: gelinta {ins}, soo-baxa {outs}.
